action.purchase_policy: Preview sends only plan_id/state_version. It sends no confirmed flag, idempotency key or purchase request; no order is created by this setup.

action.failure_policy: Missing, unsuccessful, unowned, stale or ambiguous preview fails03a and leaves the subsequent model step NOT_REACHED, without sending the compound message.
action.preservation: All R5 utterances, original step IDs01..12, case ordering, existing checks and other cases remain unchanged. Only the explicit03a UI action, GROUP04 bootstrap label and additive T4 selection predicates differ.

counterfactuals: No quote, foreign owner/session/trip/plan, stale or boolean versions, inactive quote, inconsistent quote aliases, missing/empty/duplicate hotel IDs, stale shown-plan metadata and failed preview are rejected.
